name: FoodBankDistributionConsole
tagline: Check-in, eligibility, allotments, packing queue and pounds distributed – one app for every pantry shift.
description: A complete food bank / pantry distribution app in one PCF control: search a household, see every eligibility check (income limit by household size, service area, ID, recertification, monthly visit limit and days between visits), check in with proxy pickup or a logged override, pack from a household-size allotment limited by remaining stock, run a live Checked in → Packing → Ready → Collected queue, and report pounds, households and individuals served.
features: Monthly visit limit and minimum days between visits
Override with required reason or denied visit
Pick list limited by stock with short warnings
Dietary and language flags for packers
Pounds / households / individuals KPIs, children and seniors reached
